capabilities: Scan UPC barcodes with a USB or Bluetooth scanner to look up releases
Search Discogs and MusicBrainz by title, artist, label, composer, and conductor
Save release notes with YAML frontmatter, cover art, and custom fields
Track condition grades, copy counts, values, and acquisition dates
Create and manage a Bases table view with pre-configured catalog views
disambiguation: Not a music player; it catalogs physical vinyl and CD releases as notes, it does not play or manage audio files.
extras: Makes network requests to Discogs and MusicBrainz (only the barcode or search terms are sent, no vault data). Desktop-only for plugin features; notes and the Base view are readable on iOS. Requires Obsidian v1.8.0+ for Bases support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to catalog a physical music collection with automatic metadata and cover art lookup.

relations.evidence: automatically pull metadata from Discogs and MusicBrainz
MusicBrainz | UPC lookup and title/artist search (fallback)

summary: Music collection cataloger that scans UPC barcodes or searches Discogs and MusicBrainz to create release notes with metadata, queryable via Bases.
